findings.what: Credit score can be farmed by moving the card statement day forward each day: every move cancels the pending statement and schedules one from now, and a statement with nothing owed reports a month paid on time
findings.evidence: Measured with vite-node on a New York life (seed probe-sd), card at 0: 20 card.set_statement_day moves over 20 days fired 20 statements and moved the score from 640 to 700 (past the 670 loan line and the 700 raise line). The only test is cardlife.test.ts:169, which checks the next date.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow one move per cycle (or the next statement on the new day in the following month whenever it would fall less than about a month after the last one). Also make reportMonth/annual fee one per calendar month. Add a test that moving the day can't produce two statements in a month.

findings.what: Two statements in one month (from a statement-day move) charge the yearly fee twice in the anniversary month and leave two card.due items, which can each charge a late fee and add a missed payment (suspension comes at once)
findings.where: src/engine/systems/credit.ts:709 (month-only check, comment assumes one statement a month), :736 scheduleDue, :791-831
findings.evidence: Found by reading the code, not measured. set_statement_day cancels only STATEMENT_KIND items (cardlife.ts:161-164), never a pending DUE_KIND item
findings.suggestedFix: Cancel or merge the pending due when a new statement supersedes it, and key the yearly fee on a stored lastAnnualFeeAt

findings.what: Cancelling a new savings account in its cooling-off period (and escheat closing one) leaves standing orders and scheduled payments pointing at the closed account
findings.evidence: Measured (Toronto, TD): after bank.cancel_new the order is still listed 95 days later and fails monthly with 'TD ePremium Savings is closed'. The scheduled payment ended 'done' with no notice and no posting.
findings.suggestedFix: Move closeSavings' order/payment clean-up into a shared helper and call it from cancel_new and idleAccounts. Have the scheduled payment notify when an account is closed.

findings.what: A US card's autopay that bounces is charged both the returned-payment fee and the late fee for the same missed due date. Reg Z §1026.52(b)(2)(ii) allows one penalty fee per event, and the code follows Reg Z's other limits (§1026.52(a), (b)(2)(i)(B), safe harbor)
findings.evidence: Both postings run in the same DUE handler when asked > autopayReach and paid < due; cardlife.test.ts:299 asserts only the returned fee
findings.suggestedFix: For iso US, skip the late fee when the returned-payment fee was charged for this due, or charge the larger of the two

findings.what: Card hardship plan is granted on request with no test of hardship: it freezes all interest, the payment is a 48th of the balance, and paying it counts as on time (score +), with no mark on the record
findings.evidence: No condition beyond owed>0, and the button shows whenever something is owed (BankCard.tsx:237)
findings.suggestedFix: Gate on missed payments or a fall in income, and/or report the plan (a mark or a hold on score gains)

findings.what: 'Left To Spend' on the card panel is limit minus owed. It ignores what the engine actually lets onto the card (suspension, closing, lock or stop, payment holds, the over-limit opt-in), so a suspended or locked card can show room to spend
findings.suggestedFix: Show cardRoom(person, card), and say why when it is 0

findings.what: Fraud on a card with a large-payment alert sends two 'A Large Payment' notices with different bodies, so the dedupe doesn't merge them
findings.evidence: Code reading; sim.notify merges only identical title+body (simulation.ts:716)
findings.suggestedFix: Skip category 'card-fraud' in the alerts sweep, or drop the notify in somebodyElse

findings.what: Unauthorized card charges earn rewards: NOT_PURCHASES doesn't include 'card-fraud', and the refund never takes the reward back
bank.new_number only costs something (the debit card is stopped until a replacement comes). No compromise state exists, so it changes no later outcome
findings.evidence: fraudOn draws on rng and card state alone
findings.suggestedFix: Either model a compromised number that raises fraud odds until renumbered, or say on screen that it's cosmetic

findings.what: statementAfter takes the first pending card.statement in the universe, not this person's or card's. With several cards, learnedAt can come from another card's date
Card statement periods are all cut on today's statement day. After a move, past statements no longer match the dates they were issued on
findings.suggestedFix: Derive the period bounds from the statements that actually happened (done STATEMENT_KIND items)
